description: Land Acquisition - Kobonillawatta, Ududumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Winchfield Park Watta, Ududumbara D/S Division, Kandy District - Namadagala, Medadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes (conservation of Dumbara mountain range and Knukles Range Reservation), provides detailed descriptions of the properties, lists claimants, and outlines compensation procedures. This falls squarely under the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, property ownership transfers, and land-related administrative procedures.
